title: Topic 4.1: Measuring and Marking Out Tools

pages.lesson:
LESSON: MEASURING AND MARKING OUT TOOLS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
Strand: Tools and Production
Topic 4.1: Measuring and Marking Out Tools

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Measuring and Marking Out Tools. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Measuring and Marking Out Tools
2. Practise Measuring and Marking Out Tools at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Measuring and Marking Out Tools

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Measuring and Marking Out Tools
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Measuring and Marking Out Tools. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Measuring and Marking Out Tools at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Measuring and Marking Out Tools at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Measuring and Marking Out Tools
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Measuring and Marking Out Tools. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Measuring and Marking Out Tools using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Measuring and Marking Out Tools in the examples.
2. Explain Measuring and Marking Out Tools to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Measuring and Marking Out Tools.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Measuring and Marking Out Tools using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Measuring and Marking Out Tools important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Measuring and Marking Out Tools
2. Practise Measuring and Marking Out Tools at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Measuring and Marking Out Tools

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
